notes.title: SOFIE: THE ECHOES - Patch 1.0.2 is Available Now!
notes.notes:
We’ve just rolled out a new update addressing a couple of issues some players encountered. Here’s what’s been fixed:

[list]
[*] [b]Map Loading Issue:[/b] Some players experienced the map failing to load when starting a new game. This is now resolved, so you can dive straight into the adventure without any interruptions.
[*] [b]Weapon Spawn Bug:[/b] We’ve fixed a glitch where the gun wasn’t appearing at the beginning of Level 3. It should now spawn correctly, ensuring you’re well-equipped for the challenges ahead.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and patience as we continue refining Sofie: The Echoes. We’re committed to delivering a smooth and immersive experience, and your support helps us get there.

Happy gaming,

Working Game Studio Team

notes.title: SOFIE: THE ECHOES - Patch 1.0.1 is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sofie: The Echoes Community!
[/b]
Thank you for the amazing support you’ve shown as Sofie embarks on her journey. We’ve loved seeing your recordings, discussions, and all the enthusiasm around the game!

Our first update is live on Steam! We’ve addressed some key feedback to make your experience even better.

Check out the patch notes below and let us know your thoughts. Thanks again for being part of Sofie’s adventure!

Check out the full patch notes below:


[h2]PATCH 1.0.1 CHANGELOG:[/h2]

[h3]AI & Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Improved AI:[/b] Enemies now react more naturally to sounds and have enhanced visual detection for an immersive and challenging experience.

[*] [b]Character Movement:[/b] Sofie can now move as normal—even when injured—and her footstep sounds have been reduced when crouching for a stealthier approach.

[*] [b]New Panic Indicator: [/b]Players will now see an on-screen message when Sofie experiences a panic attack, adding clarity to intense moments.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes & Optimizations[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Audio Fixes:[/b] Background and effect sounds now play consistently to ensure a fully immersive experience.

[*] [b]Navigation Improvements:[/b] AI behavior is more reliable, preventing instances of enemies getting stuck while navigating the environment.

[*] [b]Map Loading:[/b] Resolved an issue where some users experienced incomplete map loading in the first level after the elevator.

[*] [b]Input & Interaction: [/b]Fixed cases where Sofie was unresponsive to movement inputs after attempting to get the gun and pressing the elevator button. Players should also now be able to pick up the gun without issues.
[/list]

[h3]Animation Refinements[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Sofie’s Skirt Animation: [/b]Sofie’s skirt now behaves realistically when she falls, reducing unnecessary animation.

[*] [b]Death Animation: [/b]We’ve minimized Sofie’s ragdoll physics to prevent excessive movement upon death, ensuring a smoother visual experience.

[*] [b]Cover Adjustments:[/b] Sofie’s positioning when taking cover is now more accurate, improving her interaction with walls.
[/list]

[h3]Environment Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Warzone Map Update (Level 2):[/b] The road in Level 2 has been fixed for improved gameplay navigation and aesthetic consistency.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and for reporting issues as we continue to improve your experience. We appreciate your understanding and ongoing support.

notes.title: Live Gameplay Stream: Sofie: The Echoes Release Day
notes.notes:
We’re excited to invite you to the live gameplay stream of Sofie: The Echoes, happening on the game’s release day! Witness the action-packed moments and narrative depth as Sofie embarks on her journey to find her missing family. Join the developers as they play through the early levels of the game, offering insights, answering your questions, and sharing behind-the-scenes stories.

The stream will start on October 30th, 2024 at 5 PM (GMT) and will be available on Steam. Don’t miss this chance to experience the story, puzzles, and challenges with our team! Plus, we’ll have some special surprises for viewers during the stream.

Be sure to tune in and help Sofie save her loved ones!
